exposure: Disease activity at conception (active vs. low/no)
Treatment during gestation (Hydroxychloroquine, low-dose acetylsalicylic acid)
cohort: The study included 215 pregnancies from 143 pregnant women with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) managed at a Portuguese tertiary hospital.
finding: Pregnancy in SLE patients is associated with an increased incidence of adverse obstetric outcomes, and good disease control before pregnancy and adequate treatment, especially with hydroxychloroquine, are crucial for achieving the best obstetric results.
